_comment: Single source of truth for which MATLAB release this port emulates.
assemble_sicopr.py reads this to generate sicopr.py's header, and
the result exporter reads it for the results.xlsx code_revision cell.
Edit here, re-run assemble_sicopr.py -- do not edit sicopr.py's header directly.
The header used to hardcode 4p14p0 and went stale twice: the port moved to
4p15p0 for the correlation corpus, then gained 4p16p0 support, while every

primary_reference.note: 4p15p0 with the adaptive local search backported -- the build the 208-case reference workbooks were produced with. Plain 4p15p0 as distributed contains only OptFom_Local_Search.

4p14p0.note: the original translation source; retained for history, no longer emulated

4p16p0.note: adaptive local search adopted into the mainline; see docs/MATLAB_4p16p0_CHANGES.md
